experiment_data.hypothesis: CED scoring (NLI contrastive discrimination) can effectively filter 1.7B model candidates despite lower generation quality: NLI-based selection should identify high-quality evidence samples even from a capacity-limited generator.

spec.command: python -m freige.training.rsft_score_filter --input_dir /root/autodl-tmp/freige/outputs/rsft_candidates_1_7b --output_path /root/autodl-tmp/freige/outputs/rsft_scored_1_7b --nli_model_path cross-encoder/nli-deberta-v3-base --nli_device cuda:0 --scoring_mode ced --tau 0.5 --selection_strategy top_k --top_k 3
